description: The file is a React component that serves as the main page of a note-taking application. It manages state variables for notes, categories, selected note, and modal visibility, and orchestrates the composition of other components like Header, Sidebar, NotesList, and NoteModal. It includes functions for handling note saving and UI interactions such as creating new notes and selecting existing ones.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: Handles saving a note, updating existing note or adding new note with current timestamp.
